item.text: The cache already exposes `getChildren(shareId, parentLinkId)`, which returns the currently stored child links directly. I’m adding the count function on top of that and extending the listing test to verify the count after multi page fetches and across different share IDs.

The count now reads the cached child links for the requested share and parent and returns their array length. I’ve added an assertion for the 99 children loaded across two pages and a separate share with no matching cache; I’m running the focused existing test file.
The focused Jest run is still active and has only emitted the repository’s outdated Browserslist database notice so far. I’m waiting for its completion, then I’ll review the final diff.

item.text:
Added `getCachedChildrenCount(shareId, parentLinkId)` to the listing provider. It returns the length of the children currently stored in that share’s cache for the parent.

The test now checks the count after fetching two pages and confirms another share returns zero. `git diff --check` passed. The focused Jest run did not finish and was stopped after about two minutes.
